subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with detail payloads be hidden before mutating-tool handling, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose diagnostics remain visible?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface some detailed exec warnings, while the PR states that exec-like warnings should always be suppressed; automation cannot choose that user-facing policy safely.

options.title: Clarify Policy Then Revise
options.body: Keep this PR open but require a maintainer policy decision, matching code/test updates, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Sponsor Suppress-All Behavior
options.body: If all exec-like warnings should be hidden, the fix should move suppression ahead of mutating handling and update the affected diagnostic tests.

options.title: Narrow Or Close This Branch
options.body: If detailed exec diagnostics are intentional, narrow the linked issue to the remaining non-mutating case or close this PR as the wrong policy shape.

recommendation.title: Clarify Policy Then Revise
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but require a maintainer policy decision, matching code/test updates, and real behavior proof before merge.
